direction_semantics: first observed endpoint is forward; exact reverse endpoint is reverse
iat_semantics: non-negative elapsed seconds between consecutive observed packets; the first packet has no IAT and is excluded from IAT distributions
burst_semantics: a maximal contiguous run of packets with the same nonzero direction; no time threshold

duration_seconds.definition: last timestamp minus first timestamp, clipped below at zero

packet_length_mean.definition: population mean of captured frame length

packet_length_std.definition: population standard deviation of captured frame length

iat_mean_seconds.definition: mean of consecutive-packet IAT values excluding the first packet

iat_std_seconds.definition: population standard deviation of consecutive-packet IAT values excluding the first packet

direction_changes.definition: changes between consecutive nonzero packet directions

payload_bytes.definition: sum of transport payload bytes when independently recoverable; otherwise NaN

forward_bytes.definition: captured frame bytes in forward direction

reverse_bytes.definition: captured frame bytes in reverse direction

forward_length_mean.definition: mean captured frame length for forward packets; NaN when absent

forward_length_std.definition: population standard deviation for forward frame lengths; NaN when absent

reverse_length_mean.definition: mean captured frame length for reverse packets; NaN when absent

reverse_length_std.definition: population standard deviation for reverse frame lengths; NaN when absent

iat_min_seconds.definition: minimum consecutive-packet IAT excluding first packet

iat_max_seconds.definition: maximum consecutive-packet IAT excluding first packet

iat_median_seconds.definition: median consecutive-packet IAT excluding first packet

iat_p90_seconds.definition: 90th percentile consecutive-packet IAT excluding first packet

forward_iat_mean_seconds.definition: mean time between successive forward packets; NaN with fewer than two

forward_iat_std_seconds.definition: population std of successive-forward-packet IAT; NaN with fewer than two

reverse_iat_mean_seconds.definition: mean time between successive reverse packets; NaN with fewer than two

reverse_iat_std_seconds.definition: population std of successive-reverse-packet IAT; NaN with fewer than two

burst_count.definition: number of maximal same-direction packet runs

burst_bytes_mean.definition: mean captured frame bytes per burst

burst_bytes_std.definition: population std captured frame bytes per burst

burst_bytes_max.definition: maximum captured frame bytes in a burst

inter_burst_iat_mean.definition: mean next-burst-start minus previous-burst-end; NaN for one burst

inter_burst_iat_std.definition: population std of inter-burst IAT; NaN for one burst

availability_rules.FULL_FLOW_S12: exact Stage 15R E3 values and missingness; VNAT forward/reverse counts and payload remain NaN, and VNAT direction_changes remains the historical first-8 value
availability_rules.FULL_FLOW_S_A_S_AB: exact Stage 15R S12 columns plus newly registered A/B fields
availability_rules.FULL_FLOW_S_ABC_AND_LATER: full-flow C fields are activated; USTC/ISCX legacy C values must agree with replay, VNAT C values become available from exact frozen PCAP lineage; payload availability is unchanged
availability_rules.EARLY_16: every feature is calculated from at most the first 16 packets; payload remains NaN for USTC and VNAT to preserve cross-scenario availability semantics
